tasks.label: Build and test Debug
tasks.command: cmake --preset debug -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++ -DCMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH=ON && cmake --build --preset debug && ctest --preset debug

tasks.label: Build and test Release (GUI)
tasks.command: cmake --preset release-gui -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++ -DCMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH=ON && cmake --build --preset release-gui && ctest --preset release-gui

tasks.label: Build and test Release (Headless)
tasks.command: cmake --preset release-headless -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++ -DCMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH=ON && cmake --build --preset release-headless && ctest --preset release-headless
